question: The Ghadar Party was founded by Indians in the year 1913. Where was its headquarters?
solution:
The correct answer is **__San Francisco.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**Ghadar Party

__
 
• An **international political movement consisting of expatriate Indians to overthrow British rule in India.**
 
• Found on **15 July 1913 in Astoria, Oregon, the United States of America.**
 
• **Ghadar headquarters and Hindustan Ghadar newspaper** based in **San Francisco, California.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Party in the United States fractured into a **Communist and an Indian Socialist faction**.
 
• The party was formally dissolved in **1948.**
 
• **Ideologies of Party: **Indian Independence and Nationalism.
